name: input-group
useFor: Use when something belongs inside the field: a search mark, a unit or domain (segment), a copy or clear key, a count. Put InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea inside InputGroup and InputGroupAddon at either end (inline-start, inline-end) or above or below a textarea (block-start, block-end).
constraints: A second border around the inner control
Addons that are not clickable but look like keys
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the input, the search field and the merchant filter in monitoring.live)
title: Input Group
description: The brand's field with glyphs, text, keys or a mist mono segment inside its edge.
